About.title: The Architectural Developer
paragraphs: I'm a software developer based in Denizli, Turkey, focused on building scalable, detail-oriented, and user-centric web and mobile products.

On the frontend and full-stack side, I work with the modern JavaScript ecosystem — React, Next.js, Vue.js, and Svelte. On the backend I use Node.js/NestJS; for data I rely on PostgreSQL and GraphQL to meet production needs.

At Ayhanlar Holding as Software Team Lead and Full-Stack Developer, I led teams on Next.js, React Native, NestJS, TailwindCSS, Redux, and GraphQL projects — managing delivery and improving the application lifecycle.

At Rubiklabs as Full-Stack Software Developer, I shipped performance- and UX-focused products, collaborated closely with UI/UX, turned Figma designs into production-quality interfaces, and followed SEO and accessibility principles.
As a freelancer I've delivered custom web apps for clients across industries — end-to-end e-commerce-style solutions, admin panels, and user-friendly interfaces.

My stack includes React/React Native, Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, TailwindCSS, Redux, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, plus Docker and Git for delivery workflows. On DevOps I work with Kubernetes and self-hosted setups — GitLab Runner, Rancher, Harbor for CI/CD and registries, and n8n for automation. I share technical notes on my blog.
